svg.title: K33 · Two bugs in one trench coat: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 33: visitor (asks every 2 s,, prints a result); Service canteen (one stable address, with a port); Pods canteen (2) (the kitchen, all Running). Your mission: Everything says Running. Why is the counter closed?
